source_patches.description: Change the MINGW DLL naming predicate to MINGW AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS; no source code/codec changes.
source_patches.before:

  set_target_properties(
    leptonica PROPERTIES SUFFIX
                         "-${PROJECT_VERSION}${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
endif(MINGW)
source_patches.after:

    leptonica PROPERTIES SUFFIX

endif()
